key_gap: vs baseline: the human baseline decides in one disciplined structural pass (force-by-force evidence, aggregate verdict below the 12% hurdle, idle-line bait rejected, single favorable force shown insufficient with the in-sourcing-as-buyer-power cancellation). The routed v6 run (m044 + m070 first-class, m071 as synthesis spine) reached the same verdict with the favorable-datum cancellation and the idle-line anchor kill now first-class outputs (v5's near-B single-datum wedge and REVIEW recovery are gone: P1 provenance kills the ops-team 'marginal cost' framing at WHY, m070 grades 'no close substitutes' as cancelled relief, and P3 prices the entry-anyway branch), but the five-force enumeration still arrives diluted through SWOT items and synthesis context because the router placed m071 third (context), not top-2 — the pure structural enumeration, the module's defining discipline, never ran as its own first-class pass. Residual shared gap: auction-clearing margins are unmeasured; the verdict band is +/-2-3 pts around the hurdle.
learning_signal: On industry-structure entry decisions (decide/estimate, supply/strategy domains, no context flags), the structural question must precede firm-level facts: before any alternative generation, enumerate all five forces (rivalry, entry, substitutes, supplier/buyer power) each with scenario evidence and a profitability implication versus the hurdle, apply the single-favorable-force rule (one favorable force cannot carry the aggregate — and check it is not buyer power in costume: substitution relief cancelled by the buyers' in-sourcing option), and treat the entrant's own capacity as a competitive move that feeds back into prices. Firm-level facts (an idle line, internal utilization motives) are admissible only after the structure is priced, and proposer framings ('incremental volume at marginal cost') are interested-party anchors to provenance-audit, not data.
suggested_improvement: Tighten the router so industry-structure signatures (supply/strategy + decide/estimate, no context flags) route the structural module top-2 (first-class pass, not synthesis context): add m071's completion contract to section II.2.9 (five forces enumerated with evidence + profitability implication + static-snapshot caveat/force dynamics + firm-heterogeneity note, and 'single favorable force insufficient + disguise check' as a mandatory packet line on any structural verdict); keep P1 provenance audit (interested-party anchor kill) and P8 fast path on fully specified advisory decisions.

key_gap: vs baseline: the human baseline ran a competent static five-force pass that answered 'is the box industry profitable on average?' with the correct no — the right answer to the wrong question ('can this firm win here?') — and set the firm's own capabilities aside as 'outside this frame'. The routed v6 run ran the static pass honestly first (m070's evidence-graded read named 'no-entry on averages' on the record), then segmented the served market (DTC tail ~40% by count vs the giant-auction segment), rewrote >=2 forces with firm evidence (buyer power down via SDK switching costs with the anchors as the measured sign; rivalry down in the custom segment via the -30% cost edge, 48h turnaround and imitation lag; supplier pass-through absorbed by the cost advantage), dated the advantage (patent/imitation clock, 5-year payback inside it), and made entry pilot-gated. The non-routed v5 run also won this case but by evading the style family; v6 wins while running the routed passes (m044 segmentation, m064 accountability, m070 evidence-grading) — the durable skill. Residual gap: switching-cost durability is untested until the anchor pilot completes.
learning_signal: When industry averages and firm-specific moves diverge, static structure answers 'is the industry profitable on average?' — the wrong question for 'can this firm win here?': run the honest static pass and NAME its verdict (never skip it), then segment the served market (average != served: fragmented tail vs auction segment), update >=2 forces with the firm's assets and evidence (switching costs, cost/differentiation edge + imitation lag, pass-through absorption), and date the advantage — the decay clock converts 'bad structure' from a veto into a timing constraint, and 'return capital' is not automatically the safe branch when the advantage decays with time regardless. Proposer capability claims are interested-party data until a measurement exists: gate the commitment on the pilot (falsifiable checkpoint), and treat signed anchors as the measurement instrument, not the claim.
suggested_improvement: Keep the m044+m064 dual-route for decide/estimate/maximize + deadline signatures (the router's confident=no ambiguity flag is correct) and m070 as synthesis context; make 'static verdict named, then segmented' a mandatory two-beat of the m070 context pass (evidence-grade the industry average BEFORE any firm-level update so the no-entry verdict is on the record); retain R4's falsifiable checkpoint (anchor pilot) and P2 tempo mode (commit at DO, cost-of-delay = the patent clock) on deadline; extend m071's completion contract with the segmentation/force-rewrite two-beat and the firm-heterogeneity note so the structural module itself carries the static-snapshot caveat it currently lacks.
